compound_set.authority: metadata/queries/query-registry.json: every query with intent_id == product_liquid is one required primary query, and its compound_id is a compound the design covers. This block does not restate that list.

declared_not_yet_collected.reason: The compound was added to this study's registered set on 2026-11-10 (canonical identity already existed in metadata/taxonomy/compound-taxonomy.skos.jsonld as compound_cbc, so no new identity decision was needed). No YouTube run exists for `CBC リキッド`: the query string is registered so the requirement is visible, not to report a measurement. run 0 is neither observed_zero nor missing.
Registered on 2026-11-10 against the existing canonical concept compound_cbdv; no `CBDV リキッド` run has been executed. Same not_collected state as compound_cbc.

compound_set.coverage_state_note: compound_thcnm's two required primary queries (`thcnm-liquid-ja` = THCNM リキッド and `tha-liquid-ja` = THA リキッド) each have an adopted run collected on 2026-11-04: declaration metadata/provenance/declarations/20261104-youtube-thcnm-tha-liquid-cannabinoid-raw-collection.json, runs and counts in data-catalog.json. They are two independent runs; their counts are not merged and neither substitutes for the other. compound_cbc (`cbc-liquid-ja`) and compound_cbdv (`cbdv-liquid-ja`) were added to the registered set on 2026-11-10 and have no run yet, so `make audit-youtube-coverage` reports compound_cbc and compound_cbdv as missing_compounds while the 15 previously declared compounds stay complete (16/18 required queries adopted). This block is the design declaration, not a measurement: absence of a run is not a zero observation.
compound_set.coverage_rule: Two levels, both reported. Query level: a required primary query is covered when at least one adopted run carries that query_id. Compound level: a compound is complete only when all of its required primary queries are covered; some-but-not-all is `partial`, none is `missing`. One run covers only its own query_id and is never substituted for another query, and counts are never summed across queries or runs.
compound_set.identity_caveat: compound_thcnm's chemical identity is supplier/market-reported and unconfirmed. THA is an alias / commercial name of the same compound, not a second substance: both required primary queries resolve to compound_thcnm, and the two runs measure two query strings, not two substances. The query terms are the registry's canonical_text, so a run measures content matching that string, not a verified substance (ISS-20261104-TAX-028).

query_designs.retained_out_of_scope_policy: Raw payloads and declarations for out-of-primary runs stay in place as provenance. They are excluded from primary coverage counts and are never treated as a required companion run.
query_designs.rationale: This collection observes a Japanese-market product signal, not a country-limited platform count. (a) The actor input has no geo filter. (b) The Japanese product term リキッド approximates a market restriction through the query language. (c) That approximation is not a geographic guarantee. A bare compound term is not limited to Japanese product content, so it measures a different unit and is outside the primary design.
limitations: Query-language restriction is approximate: Japanese-language content about non-Japanese markets, and non-Japanese-language content about the Japanese market, are not separated.
The actor returns a search-result sample, not a census.
Out-of-primary runs do not complete coverage for any compound.

`CBC` is also an acronym outside this domain (for example the Canadian Broadcasting Corporation), so the registered string `CBC` and `CBC リキッド` measure content matching that string, not a verified substance. Neither compound has a run yet (2026-11-10), so no observed series exists to review under this caveat.

distribution.reason: The distribution slice uses the COL-033 YouTube declaration only; the raw study's YouTube runs are outside that slice. THCNM is outside the slice in every case: it has no YouTube run in this study and none in COL-033. compound_cbc and compound_cbdv are outside the slice as well: they were added to the study's registered set on 2026-11-10 and have no run in any source, so nothing about them enters a release. Registering a compound does not widen the slice.
